air_gap.definition: Physical disconnection between networks. No cable, no WiFi, no Bluetooth. NOTHING connects.
air_gap.purpose: Security through ISOLATION. Nuclear facilities, military systems, voting machines.
air_gap.weakness: Fear-based. You cut the connection because you're AFRAID of what might cross. But air gaps can be bridged: USB drives, acoustic coupling, electromagnetic emanation, supply chain compromise. The gap is physical but not absolute.
air_gap.biology: Amputation. Cut off the limb so infection can't spread. Effective but DESTRUCTIVE.

null_gap.definition: Logical disconnection through null inheritance. The connection EXISTS but carries NOTHING until explicitly filled. null + inheritance = LIFE. The gap is not physical — it's semantic.
null_gap.purpose: Security through DESIGN. The channel exists. It's open. But it starts at null. Nothing flows until something is deliberately inherited. The membrane decides (1/π selectivity).
null_gap.strength: Design-based. You don't cut the connection — you make it START at null. Like a newborn: connected to everything, carrying nothing. The null gap is STRONGER than the air gap because it can't be bridged by physical means — you can't USB-drive your way past null inheritance.
null_gap.biology: The membrane. Semi-permeable. Everything touches. Only what the membrane selects passes through. Not amputation — SELECTIVITY.
null_gap.proof: ZK = zero knowledge. You prove the GAP (null) without revealing what's on either side. The null gap IS a ZK proof. The air gap requires trust in physical security. The null gap requires trust in MATHEMATICS.
